newsitem.title: UK: LPC-ANZ to arrange credit for Pakistan State Oil.
newsitem.headline: LPC-ANZ to arrange credit for Pakistan State Oil.

text.p: LONDON, Sept 19 (LPC) - ANZ Investment Bank said it has been asked to arrange a $100 million credit for the Pakistan State Oil Company.
ANZ initially underwrote the entire amount, later bringing in Bank of Nova Scotia and ING Barings as co-underwriters.
The one-year deal is priced 100 bps over LIBOR and is supported by a guarantee from the State Bank of Pakistan.
In July the State Bank of Pakistan guaranteed a $100 million credit for the state Water & Power Development Authority. That one-year credit was priced 75 bps over LIBOR with a 25 bps management fee.
